LGTM
Tests are failing here and in just about every PR.  I've restarted here just in case.

> Error: building at STEP "RUN useradd -u 579841 -g 67283 -s /bin/bash -m crunbuild": ensuring mount targets for container "702e31018af8da78195aa78f9cf4724da2cf223dd9bee4d8f1be069bbbb3bd50": copier: ensure: error checking item "dev/mqueue": mkdir /dev/mqueue: permission denied

I tried that but that produces a different error compared to your linked Jira. I don't see how /dev/mqueue would relate to setuid xattr's?
AFAICT this error has been fixed on main already but not 1.45 based on my testing then but maybe I tested the wrong thing somehow.

this linked jira has EOVERFLOW as error so I assumed we should expect that here as well and not just a generic EACCES, or did the error change between kernel versions?

sorry for the confusion, for the test above I've used an old buildah that doesn't have [599dbf62fc](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/commit/599dbf62fc) so it fails earlier and I've not checked the error message, just that it fails.
